## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复官方 ChatGPT OAuth 原生桌面实例被管理器的语言、速度、Ultra、CDP、`NODE_OPTIONS` 或首页导航适配改写的问题。实例现在直接使用已安装客户端的原版界面，保留该实例已有的语言、首页、外观和功能偏好；客户端升级后不再因为管理器的界面补丁版本而产生入口不一致。
- 启动预览明确标识官方账号使用客户端原版界面，并补充 OAuth 身份投影与配置保留契约测试。
- 本修复只改变 Codex 官方 OAuth 的原生桌面启动路径。Local API OAuth、API Key / PAT 及其他兼容模式继续使用各自的网关和兼容能力；本版本没有引入空 `id_token` 或 access-only OAuth 格式。

- Fixes Codex native ChatGPT OAuth desktop instances being rewritten by manager language, speed, Ultra, CDP, `NODE_OPTIONS`, or home-navigation integrations. The instance now uses the installed client's original UI and preserves its existing language, home, appearance, and feature preferences, so a client update does not create a manager-version-dependent entry point.
- The launch preview identifies the original official UI and adds OAuth identity projection and configuration-preservation contract tests.
- This fix is limited to the native desktop launch path for Codex ChatGPT OAuth. Local API OAuth, API Key / PAT, and other compatibility modes retain their respective gateway and compatibility behavior; this release does not introduce an empty `id_token` or access-only OAuth format.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit completely before installing an update. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

Codex 官方账号的原生桌面实例使用已安装客户端的原版界面；API 桌面模式仍按客户端能力使用语言、速度和 Ultra 兼容适配。Claude Desktop、Claude Code CLI、API / 第三方连接等既有已验证能力保持不变，客户端需单独安装。真实付费账号的 ChatGPT 登录、模型权限和上游请求仍由官方客户端与账号服务决定。

Native desktop instances for official Codex accounts use the installed client's original UI. API desktop modes continue to use language, speed, and Ultra compatibility adapters according to the client capabilities. Existing verified Claude Desktop, Claude Code CLI, and API / third-party connection capabilities are unchanged; clients must be installed separately. ChatGPT sign-in, model access, and upstream requests for a real paid account remain controlled by the official client and account service.

- 来源标签：[v0.11.3](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.11.3)；对应发布工作流记录见 [release workflow](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/actions/workflows/release.yml?query=branch%3Av0.11.3)。

- 这些测试使用隔离目录、合成 OAuth 身份和 fixture 客户端；没有把真实账号、token 或私有路径写入源码或 Release，也没有宣称真实付费账号的 Chat / Code / Cowork 端到端登录已由本批测试完成。
- 安装包与校验清单发布在 [v0.11.3 Release](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/releases/tag/v0.11.3)，校验文件为 [`SHA256SUMS.txt`](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/releases/download/v0.11.3/SHA256SUMS.txt)。

- Source tag: [v0.11.3](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.11.3); the matching [release workflow record](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/actions/workflows/release.yml?query=branch%3Av0.11.3) is tied to that tag's source commit.
- Local checks: `npm run test:ci` (1361 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed), `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build:proxy`, Go sidecar and CLIProxyAPI handler tests, `npm run build`, `npm run test:native-identity`, and `npm run test:desktop:instance-models`.
- These checks use isolated directories, synthetic OAuth identities, and fixture clients. No real account, token, or private path is included in source or release metadata, and the checks do not claim end-to-end Chat / Code / Cowork sign-in for a real paid account.
- Installers and checksums are published in the [v0.11.3 Release](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/releases/tag/v0.11.3); the checksum manifest is [`SHA256SUMS.txt`](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/releases/download/v0.11.3/SHA256SUMS.txt).
